name: The Vale of the Hollow
note: Hand-written. Coordinates are on a 1000 x 700 parchment. A location's map/spawn is where travelling there puts you; 'locked' ones show on the map but can't be reached yet; 'known' ones are on the map from the start, the rest appear once visited (or once a neighbour is visited, if 'seen' lists it).

locations.name: Hollowmere
locations.blurb: A river town half-emptied by the Unweaving. The west still stands; across the Hollow it is falling down.

locations.name: The Corvanthe Road
locations.blurb: The old cobbled road from Hollowmere to the walls of Corvanthe. Gleaners camp along it.

locations.name: Corvanthe
locations.blurb: The great university city, ruined in the Unweaving. Its citizens walk its streets still, as Echoes. The gleaners have cut a way in through the Wardgate, into Cindergate.
